title: Streaming Buried CDs, Vinyl AND Downloads Combined
source: RIAA year-end and mid-year U.S. recorded music revenue reports. Streaming revenue: .24B (2015), ~.03B (2016, the year streaming became the largest format), .7B (2017), .8B (2019), 2.4B (2021), 4.4B (2023). Physical + digital downloads combined: .48B (2015), ~.4B (2016), ~.5B (2017), ~.8B (2019), ~.6B (2021), ~.39B (2023, physical formats partly rebounded on vinyl). Figures approximate, derived from RIAA-reported percentage shares of total industry revenue.
